poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pose reference sheet for a tiny website companion named Hito.
Use the attached images as authoritative character identity references, not as backgrounds. Hito is the SEDIPRO UNT purple owl in a royal-blue short-sleeved polo: two upward purple ear tufts, big rounded white feather face discs, large dark purple irises with BLACK round pupils and bright white eye reflections, small curved yellow beak with cheerful smile, rounded purple body, yellow bird feet with three black claw tips, purple feather arms like the reference. White small SEDIPRO origami mark on left chest. Preserve this exact recognizable character and proportions (head around 40% of height, polo torso around 40%, lower body and legs 20%), NOT an oversized square-headed kawaii reinterpretation.
Style: polished soft-pixel 3D game sprite, softly shaded like the supplied owl, subtle fine pixel texture and a clean lightly stepped outline, rounded contours and genuinely round eyes. At 80x96 displayed size it should look like the ORIGINAL owl miniaturized, not a chunky 32px retro icon. No thick black outlines, no rectangular eyes, no square shirt, no blurry photo. All poses share identical character identity, material, blue collar, ear shapes, size, lighting and proportions.
Create ONE pose reference sheet with exactly EIGHT full-body isolated characters in a precise FOUR-column TWO-row layout, evenly spaced with large transparent gutters, each centered in its own equal cell, entire body including ear tufts and toes visible, all standing feet aligned on each row's common baseline, SAME scale. Image aspect ratio 3:2, approx 1536x1024.
Reading order:
row 1: (1) front neutral standing, arms relaxed down, both eyes open; (2) front waving with its RIGHT feather hand raised (screen-left), other hand down; (3) front thinking, one hand touching cheek, eyes looking slightly upward; (4) front sleepy, both eyelids fully closed, arms relaxed.
row 2: (5) front working with a small dark-blue laptop held against its belly BELOW the face; (6) front celebrating, both feather hands raised, joyful face; (7) front spreading its feather arms to both sides like reference image 2; (8) front affectionate, hands together on chest, warm smile.
No floating hearts, no confetti, no writing or captions, no grid lines, no cell labels, no motion marks, no shadows outside character, no floor. Actual transparent background with preserved alpha. Don't include any reference backgrounds. No image border.

walking.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight-frame walking animation sheet for Hito, a purple SEDIPRO UNT owl website pet.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED Hito identity and rendering style. Input image 2 is Hito's anatomical side-profile reference. Input image 3 is ONLY A GAIT/POSE REFERENCE: the eight phases of Fireball's screen-right walking cycle. Preserve Hito's owl anatomy and blue SEDIPRO polo, and transfer ONLY the foot alternation, arm counter-swing, slight forward lean, subtle body bob and eight-pose walking cadence from image 3. Never borrow Fireball's head/body/flame/face/clothing.
Produce exactly EIGHT sequential frames, ordered left-to-right in row 1 then row 2, in a regular FOUR-column TWO-row sheet, image aspect 3:2, about 1536x1024. Each equally sized cell has the SAME owl at the SAME scale centered with its feet on a shared ground baseline. All eight poses face SCREEN-RIGHT in a readable three-quarter SIDE view like the Fireball gait reference. The owl's beak projects rightward and the near right eye is fully visible, far eye partially visible. Body, beak, eyes, feathers, shirt, collar, sleeve and white chest mark remain consistent in every frame.
Pose sequence: 1 left foot forward/right foot back (contact), 2 left supporting/right lifting (down), 3 right foot passes supporting left (passing), 4 right foot forward/left behind (up), 5 right foot planted forward/left back (opposite contact), 6 right supporting/left lifting (down), 7 left passes supporting right (passing), 8 left foot moving forward/right behind (up, reconnect naturally to frame 1). Feet have yellow toes and black claws. Feet must alternate VISIBLY; avoid repeating the same leg pose. Arms feather-hands swing opposite the leading foot, tail follows gently. Body bob at most a few pixels, don't vary character size, don't run or sprint or jump. No feet sliding, no limb detachment.
Identity: rounded purple owl with upward purple ear tufts, round white feather eye masks, large purple irises and black round pupils with white glints, friendly yellow curved beak, rounded royal-blue polo torso, purple lower body, yellow bird feet. Match the original proportions, facial features and softly shaded 3D toy material of image 1. Soft fine-pixel game sprite feel, smooth rounded contours, NOT chunky retro pixel art, NOT square eyes or oversized chibi head.
All entire characters must stay inside their cells with generous TRANSPARENT gutters. Actual transparent RGBA background. No background gradients, no halos, no glow, no shadows, no floor, no motion effects, no labels, no guide lines, no captions.
walking.finalEditPrompt:
Edit ONLY the limb pose/cadence of the Hito walking sheet (image 1), using image 2 ONLY as the eight-stage walking phase reference. Keep Hito's head, round eyes, purple owl identity, blue SEDIPRO polo, tail, material, scale, lighting, cell layout and transparent alpha unchanged.
The current sheet repeats almost the same foot positions in both halves. Fix it into a TRUE ALTERNATING WALK CYCLE: the NEAR leg and NEAR arm must visibly move from forward to backward across frames, and the far limbs counter-swing. Do not leave the near hand hanging at the same position in every frame. Do not leave the near foot forward in all eight frames.
Keep FOUR columns by TWO rows, reading order 1..8. All birds face screen-right:
1 NEAR foot stretched FORWARD to screen-right; FAR foot trailing left; NEAR arm swung BACK to screen-left.
2 near foot supporting under forward torso, far foot lifting to pass; near arm moving toward neutral.
3 near foot planted under torso, far foot passing ahead; near arm neutral alongside torso.
4 near foot now TRAILING LEFT of torso, far foot reaches forward screen-right; near arm swinging FORWARD.
5 OPPOSITE CONTACT: FAR foot stretched FORWARD to screen-right, NEAR foot stretched BACKWARD to screen-left, and the NEAR hand reaching FORWARD to screen-right. THIS MUST LOOK DIFFERENT FROM FRAME 1.
6 far foot supports forward torso, NEAR foot lifts BEHIND left of torso; near hand forward.
7 far foot planted under torso, NEAR foot passes center toward screen-right; near hand moves back toward neutral.
8 near foot now reaches forward screen-right, far foot trailing left; near arm moving BACK toward frame 1.
Separate feet clearly at each contact, toes yellow and claws black. Bent knees only during passing. Clear arm counter-swing like Fireball but keep Hito's short blue sleeves and purple feather hands. Gentle body bob only, no sprinting or exaggerated leap. Feet on one common ground baseline. Preserve exact body size and owl style; only animate limbs. No new effects or background. Transparent RGBA cutouts, no gradient backdrop, no shadows, no halos, no motion marks or labels.
